headlineOfDay: Trump names hardliner Stephen Miller chief of staff days after Republicans lose both chambers, as AI stocks rebound from a $3.2tn rout.

markets.summary: Wall Street staged a tepid recovery after a rout of about $3.2tn driven by fears that a Democratic Congress will slow the AI build-out; the Nasdaq rose 1.09% and the S&P 500 0.31%, while the Dow slipped 0.46%. The FTSE 100 and Euro Stoxx 50 each fell about 1% as European markets followed the earlier US tech sell-off. A stronger US jobs report added to rate worries.

commodities.label: Brent crude
commodities.note: Brent was little changed on the day, but oil fell sharply over the week on hopes of a US-Iran peace deal.
